entries.reason: AH999 (l.1905, EXIT) is entered only by falling out of `IF WS-STORM-DRAIN = 'N'` (l.1897): the true arm ends in EXEC CICS ABEND, which does not return, and the false arm needs WS-STORM-DRAIN 'Y', which only the AFCR/AFCS/AFCT arm sets and that arm ends in EXEC CICS RETURN (see the entry for l.1897). Nothing PERFORMs or GO TOs AH999.

`IF COMM-FAIL-CODE = '2'` (l.406, under `IF COMM-SUCCESS = 'N'` after PERFORM UPDATE-ACCOUNT-DB2-TO at l.398) is false only if UPDATE-ACCOUNT-DB2-TO returns COMM-SUCCESS 'N' with a fail code other than '2'. The paragraph sets 'N' at l.1044 and leaves it only by GO TO UADT999 (l.1181) after MOVE '2' (l.1103, the +100 arm) or by the 'Y' at l.1557; the other fail code it sets, '3' (l.1188), is followed by the -911 handling and then COMPUTE/UPDATE from unset host variables, and every failure after that (UPDATE -180, the deadlock/timeout exhaustion arms, a failing SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) ends in EXEC CICS ABEND, which does not return. No input returns 'N' with a code other than '2' (the to-select/to-update -911 and 923 scenarios all abend).

`IF COMM-FAIL-CODE NOT = '2'` (l.766, the ELSE of `IF COMM-SUCCESS = 'Y'` at l.606 after PERFORM UPDATE-ACCOUNT-DB2-TO at l.600) is true only if UPDATE-ACCOUNT-DB2-TO returns COMM-SUCCESS 'N' with a fail code other than '2': the same fact as the false arm of l.406 -- UPDATE-ACCOUNT-DB2-TO returns 'N' only by GO TO UADT999 after MOVE '2' (l.1103/1181); its other failure code '3' (l.1188) goes on to an UPDATE that fails -180 and ends in EXEC CICS ABEND, which does not return.

`IF WS-STORM-DRAIN = 'N'` (l.1897) is false only when WS-STORM-DRAIN is 'Y'. It starts 'N' (l.242) and is set 'Y' only at l.1810, in the WHEN 'AFCR'/'AFCS'/'AFCT' arm of the EVALUATE, which ends in EXEC CICS RETURN (l.1892) before END-EVALUATE (l.1895), so l.1897 is never reached with 'Y'.
